verdict.rationale: OpenAI has a dedicated prompt-caching guide: requests sharing a prompt prefix reuse work, and reused tokens are billed at a cached-input rate discounted up to 90%. The pricing page lists cached-input and cache-write prices per model, and the rate-limits guide explains that cached tokens still count toward TPM limits. Missing for 10: an explicit documented latency-reduction figure (only implied by 'reuses work'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the savings.
